ios.desc:
VocabAI is a daily vocabulary builder: choose a language, your level and your topics, then learn new words with flashcards, quizzes, games and AI example sentences.

ELEVEN LANGUAGES TO LEARN
English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Finnish, Estonian and Persian (Farsi). Every level from A1 to C2, with topics such as travel or food.

YOUR DAILY WORD FEED
Swipe through your flashcards: right when you know a word, left when you want it to come back later. Every third card brings a quick quiz question. You decide how many new words you learn each day.

UNDERSTAND WORDS IN CONTEXT
Listen to the pronunciation and open AI example sentences. Tap any word in a sentence to see grammar notes.

FIVE GAMES
Multiple choice, match the pairs, sound match, story fill and fill the gap. Every game uses the words you have already learned.

YOUR LEARNING PATH
Each month is a path: every day you learn fills a tile, play steps wait along the way and a plant grows with your progress. Open any past day to see its words again.

STREAKS, XP AND REMINDERS
Earn XP, keep your daily streak and celebrate milestones. A daily reminder at the time you choose helps you keep going.

COLLECTIONS
Save words to your own collections or explore public word collections.

IN YOUR LANGUAGE
The app is available in English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch and Persian, with light and dark mode.

FREE OR PREMIUM
Free: 10 or 15 new words a day, three games without limits, one story a day, example sentences for two words a day, up to three collections and up to 200 XP a day, with ads.
VocabAI Premium: no ads, 20 new words a day, unlimited hearts, example sentences and stories, the fill-the-gap game, more collections and unlimited XP.
